title: Benchmarking Pretrained Vision Embeddings for Near- and Duplicate Detection in Medical Images
mechanism: Pretrained foundation-model embeddings with cosine thresholds find near-duplicate images that bias evaluation.
adaptation: Embed all cells (582, E1, F51/H36, UCF-EL, pool) with the DINOv2/v3 encoders already used in the linear probes. Flag cross-split pairs above the threshold and check them against module ids.
min_experiment: Near-duplicate scan, then the house score on test cells with vs without a near-duplicate in train. Decision: move flagged pairs into the same fold if the score gap > 0.03.
evidence: R: compares pretrained embeddings for near-duplicate detection in medical images (abstract level only).
